instruction: I want my plain text emails to wrap at 60 characters per line instead of the default 72. Please change the plain text wrap length setting to 60 characters.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the plain text wrap length (mailnews.wraplength) to 60 characters. Evaluator checks if the preference is set to 60. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: plain text wrap length set to 60 characters
Getter logic is correct: fetches Thunderbird prefs.js from the correct VM path
Metric logic is correct: check_thunderbird_prefs parses prefs.js and verifies mailnews.wraplength equals 60
Expected value is semantically correct: mailnews.wraplength=60 is the correct Thunderbird preference for plain text wrap length
Postconfig is appropriate: closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before reading
Data flow is sound: VM file fetch → prefs.js parsing → preference extraction → value comparison
Complete coverage: all requirements in instruction are verified by the evaluator

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
